name: Daniyal Selani
bio:
PhD Researcher working at TU Delft and LUMC, working with the SPIDeRR Consortium on multi-modal embeddings and manifold alignment. 
The focus of my work is to use data from multiple sources to perform clinically relevant classification and clustering tasks. 
My background is in data science, computer engineering and deep learning.

name: Inez den Hond
bio:
PhD candidate working at LUMC and TU Delft, background in Biomedical Sciences (BSc) & Bioinformatics (MSc). 
My work focuses on disentangling the clinical and molecular heterogeneity of rheumatoid arthritis by integrating multiple data types (clinical, genetics, transcriptomics).

name: Bahar Sedaghatikhayat
bio:
Postdoctoral researcher, specializing in population genetics and genetic epidemiology. 
My work focuses on utilizing polygenic risk scores (PRS) to refine disease risk prediction, stratify patient populations, and bridge the gap between genetics and clinical practice.
